title: LeViT-UNet++: Towards Balanced Fine-Grained Details and Context for Efficient Medical Image Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22482v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Efficient medical image segmentation is essential for clinical applications requiring fast and accurate delineation, such as surgical navigation, radiation therapy, and real-time image-guided intervention. Despite substantial advances in convolutional neural networks and Transformers, attaining high accuracy under limited computational resources remains difficult, because reducing model complexity often sacrifices fine-grained structural details and global context modeling, yielding an unfavorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. To address this, we propose LeViT-UNet++, an efficient encoder-decoder architecture that better balances local detail preservation and global context modeling. translated_title: LeViT-UNet++：面向高效医学图像分割的细粒度细节与上下文平衡
translated_abstract: 高效的医学图像分割对于需要快速且精确勾画的临床应用至关重要，例如手术导航、放射治疗和实时图像引导介入。尽管卷积神经网络和Transformer已取得显著进展，但在有限计算资源下实现高精度仍然困难，因为降低模型复杂度往往会牺牲细粒度结构细节和全局上下文建模，从而导致不理想的精度-效率权衡。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LeViT-UNet++，这是一种高效的编码器-解码器架构，能够更好地平衡局部细节保留与全局上下文建模。具体而言，我们引入了Haar小波多尺度下采样（HWMD）模块，将特征表示分解为低频和高频分量以提取多尺度结构信息，从而缓解下采样过程中的细节损失
tldr: LeViT-UNet++通过引入Haar小波多尺度下采样模块的高效编码器-解码器架构，在有限计算资源下实现了医学图像分割中细粒度细节保留与全局上下文建模的良好平衡。
en_tdlr: LeViT-UNet++ introduces an efficient encoder-decoder architecture with a Haar Wavelet Multi-Scale Downsampling module to balance fine-grained detail preservation and global context modeling for medical image segmentation under limited computational resources.
